app.name: Story Agent Studio
health.title: Pipeline health
error.service_unreachable.remediation: Make sure the service is running (storyagent media healthcheck shows the state), then retry.
error.service_rejected.remediation: Check that the service supports these parameters/models, adjust and retry.
error.workflow_failed.remediation: Check the job event log for the failing node; adjust prompt or parameters and retry.
error.tool_failed.remediation: Read the tool output at the end of the job log; check model files and free memory, then retry.
error.timeout.remediation: Lower resolution/frames/tier, or raise timeout_sec for this model in config, then retry.
error.missing_model.remediation: Run storyagent media healthcheck to list what is missing; downloads need your explicit confirmation.
error.missing_tool.remediation: Check the tool path in services.toml, or install it, then retry.
error.invalid_params.remediation: Fix the parameters as indicated; to let unknown ones through, turn strict_params off.
error.invalid_input.remediation: Provide or replace the input (prompt, reference image/audio, ...) and retry.
error.consent_required: Voice cloning needs a recorded consent for the reference voice
error.consent_required.remediation: Tick consent on the character voice and add a note, or turn compliance checks off for this project (at your own responsibility).
error.license_ack_required: Model {model} has a non-commercial licence and the project has not acknowledged it
error.license_ack_required.remediation: Explicitly allow restricted-licence models in project settings, or pick another model.
error.output_missing: The job reported success but no output file was found
error.output_missing.remediation: Check the adapter log; the job is not marked completed and can simply be retried.
error.output_invalid.remediation: Retry; if it keeps happening check disk space and the encoder.
error.cancelled.remediation: Resubmit or retry if you want to continue.
error.worker_lost: The worker running this job stopped and retries are exhausted
error.worker_lost.remediation: Restart the worker and retry; keep the computer awake for long jobs.
error.internal.remediation: Send the job event log to the developer; try once more first.
wait.heavy_busy: Waiting for another heavy job to finish
wait.llm_resident: An LLM is still resident in memory; run storyagent ops llm-unload and the job will continue
health.col.name: Entry
cli.job.deduplicated: An identical request is already active; returning job {id}
cli.spec.unchanged: No change, no new version (current v{version})
cli.spec.is_locked: This spec is locked; unlock it first
api.error.not_found.remediation: Refresh the list; it may have been removed or the id is wrong.
api.error.conflict: That action conflicts with the item's current state.
api.error.conflict.remediation: Reload the item and check its state before trying again.
api.error.invalid.remediation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
api.error.spec_locked: This item is locked and cannot be edited.
api.error.asset_file_missing: The file for this asset is missing on disk.
api.error.asset_file_missing.remediation: Regenerate the asset, or restore the file from a backup.
api.error.internal: Something went wrong on our side.
api.error.internal.remediation: Try again; if it keeps happening, check the server log.
api.error.too_large: The file is larger than the upload limit.
api.error.too_large.remediation: Upload a smaller file, or raise [api] max_upload_mb in services.toml.
api.error.shot_locked: This shot is locked and cannot be edited.
api.error.shot_locked.remediation: Unlock the shot first, then edit it.
api.error.nothing_to_do.remediation: Pick the stages to redo (and tick force) if you want to regenerate something.
workflow.progress.queued: Waiting for a worker to pick it up
workflow.error.needs_stage.remediation: Start the run from that stage; later stages depend on it.
workflow.error.no_premise: The project has no description to start from.
workflow.error.no_premise.remediation: Write one or two sentences about the story in the project description.
workflow.error.cancelled.remediation: Start it again; finished work is kept and only the rest is done.
workflow.error.agent_spec.remediation: Fix the agent file named in the details, or remove your override of it.
llm.error.unreachable: The language model service cannot be reached.
llm.error.unreachable.remediation: Start Ollama (or the configured server) and run the step again; finished work is kept.
llm.error.timeout: The language model took too long to answer.
llm.error.timeout.remediation: Try again, use a smaller model, or raise the timeout in llm.toml.
llm.error.model_missing: The model “{model}” is not installed on the backend.
llm.error.model_missing.remediation: Pull the model (for example ollama pull) or pick another one in llm.toml.
llm.error.bad_output: The model did not return a usable answer after several tries.
llm.error.bad_output.remediation: Run the step again; if it repeats, try a stronger model for this role.
llm.error.backend_error: The language model service returned an error.
llm.error.backend_error.remediation: Check the service log, then run the step again.
llm.error.no_backend: No such language model backend is configured.
llm.error.no_backend.remediation: Fix the backend name in llm.toml.
cli.workflow.queued: Queued run {id} ({stages}). A worker will pick it up.
web.app.name: Story Studio
web.error.network_hint: Check that “storyagent serve” is running, then reload.
web.projects.title: Projects
web.projects.name: Name
web.projects.premise_hint: One or two sentences: who, what happens, where.
web.projects.empty: No projects yet. Create one above.
web.story.empty: Nothing here yet. Run the production first.
web.field.name: Name
web.field.title: Title
web.creative.empty: Nothing to edit yet. Run the production first.
web.creative.pick: Pick something on the left to edit its prompt and make new takes.
web.creative.note_hint: What did you change and why?
web.creative.needs_review: Something this depends on changed. Check it still fits.
web.creative.stale_hint: The prompt changed since this was made.
workflow.error.produce_failed: Some pictures, voices or clips could not be made.
workflow.error.produce_failed.remediatio: Open the Jobs tab to see why, fix it (for example start the missing service), then continue; finished media is kept.
workflow.error.compose_failed: The episode could not be assembled.
workflow.error.compose_failed.remediatio: Open the Jobs tab for the ffmpeg message, then run this step again.
web.workflow.make_media_hint: Pictures, voices, music and video for every shot (draft quality first).
web.workflow.needs_worker: A worker must be running to make media (storyagent worker).
web.episode.title: Episode
web.compose.warning.no_picture: Shot {shot} has no picture: it is a black card.
web.compose.warning.no_video: Shot {shot} has only a still image (slow zoom).
web.compose.warning.missing_speech: Shot {shot}, line {line} has no voice: subtitle only.
web.story.edit_hint: Change anything the AI wrote. After editing, use “Run this stage” on Generation specs so prompts follow the story; specs you edited yourself are never overwritten.
web.story.confirm_delete: Delete this item? It cannot be undone.
web.story.then_specs: Saved changes reach the generation specs when you run the Generation specs stage.
web.story.unknown_speaker: “{name}” is not one of the characters. Pick who says it, or add the character first.
web.compose.qc.readable: The episode file cannot be read
cli.project.trashed: Project {id} ({name}) moved to the recycle bin; files are kept.
web.projects.trash_confirm: Move this project to the recycle bin? Files and history are kept and you can restore it.
api.error.llm_failed: The language model could not complete this request.
api.error.llm_failed.remediation: Check that the model service is running (System page), then try again.
web.review.title: Script review
web.voice.title: Voice sample
web.voice.none: No voice sample yet: dialogue uses the default voice, if one is configured.
web.voice.consent: The speaker agreed to have this voice cloned.
web.voice.hint: 3 to 20 seconds of clean speech, and the words said in it.
web.flow.intro: The production chain, step by step: what runs, on which model, with which parameters, what each step reads and writes. Models and parameters shown are the ones a run would really use now.
web.flow.params_hint: Parameters per quality tier (model defaults, then the tier, then project overrides). A single item can override them in the Create page.
web.flow.what.analyze: Turns your premise into a production plan (genre, tone, acts, who and where) and a visual style guide.
web.flow.what.cast: Designs each character: look, personality, voice profile, picture prompt.
web.flow.what.script: Writes the outline of acts and scenes, then breaks every scene into shots with dialogue.
web.flow.what.scenes: Designs each location: look, light, picture prompt.
web.flow.what.music: Drafts background music, a theme song with lyrics, and the sound-effect list.
web.flow.what.shotplan: Builds every shot's render plan from the script: timing, camera, subject, style. No model involved.
web.flow.what.specs: Turns everything into editable generation specs (prompt, parameters, seed, references). No model, except an optional prompt writer per shot.
web.flow.what.produce: Makes pictures, voices, music and video from the specs, in dependency order, one job each.
web.flow.what.compose: Measures the voices, builds the timeline, mixes sound, burns subtitles and the AI label, checks quality.
web.process.plan_hint: What the planner decided about this story. Later steps read it. Editing changes what is generated from now on; nothing already made is touched.
web.process.style_hint: The look every picture prompt starts from. Editing applies to prompts written from now on; regenerate single items in the Create page to see it.
web.process.not_yet: Not made yet: run the first step.
web.process.bad_json: This field is a list or object: it must be valid JSON.
web.process.calls: Everything the language model was asked
web.process.calls_hint: Each row is one call: the instructions, your story data as sent, and the model's full answer.
web.prompts.intro: The instructions behind every AI step, grouped by pipeline stage. Edited wording applies to the next call (also in a running worker).
web.prompts.placeholders: Insertable data (click to insert at the cursor; replaced with your story's data when it runs):
web.prompts.system: Role and rules (read by the AI first, every time)
web.prompts.prompt: What the AI is asked to do in this step
web.prompts.reset_confirm: Discard your edits and use the built-in text again?
web.outline.hint: The script as written. Edit a scene's place, mood or beat and save: it is kept as you wrote it. Shots are edited under Shots; re-running the Script step with "redo finished" writes a new outline and replaces these edits.
web.flow.no_model: No model is configured for this: nothing is made (the step is skipped and says so).
api.error.heavy_busy: A heavy video/avatar job is running; a language model cannot run next to it.
api.error.heavy_busy.remediation: Wait for that job to finish (Jobs page) and try again. Running both at once can exhaust memory.
llm.error.heavy_busy: A heavy media job is running; the language model must wait for it.
llm.error.heavy_busy.remediation: The step continues by itself when the heavy job is done; run it again if it gave up waiting.
launch.hint.acestep: Loads about 20 GB of models; ready 25-40 seconds after starting. Needed for music and songs.
launch.hint.phosphene: Opens the Pinokio app. If the panel does not come up, press Start on Phosphene inside Pinokio.
api.error.launch_unknown.remediation: Pick a service from the launch screen.
api.error.launch_not_startable: This service cannot be started from here.
api.error.launch_not_startable.remediati: Start it yourself, or add a [launch.<service>] entry to services.toml.
api.error.launch_missing: The program or folder needed to start it was not found.
api.error.launch_missing.remediation: Check the paths under [launch.<service>] in services.toml.
api.error.launch_failed: The service could not be launched.
api.error.launch_failed.remediation: See the service's log file under the data home (logs/launch_<service>.log).
web.launch.title: Launch
web.launch.subtitle: Check the background services and start the ones that are needed.
web.launch.not_ready: Some required services are not running yet.
web.launch.starting: Starting... this page updates by itself.
agent.director.analyze.title: Director: analyse the idea
agent.director.analyze.desc: Turns the one-line idea into a production plan: title, genre, tone, summary, main characters and key locations.
agent.director.analyze.out: Title, genre, tone, summary, cast list, locations, style keywords
agent.art.style.title: Art director: visual style
agent.art.style.desc: Decides the look of the whole film; every image and video follows it so the film stays consistent.
agent.art.style.out: Colour palette, lighting, atmosphere, camera style, style prompts for the image model
agent.character.design.title: Character design
agent.character.design.desc: Writes each character's looks, personality, costume and voice, plus a prompt that generates their portrait.
agent.character.design.out: Age, appearance, personality, costume, voice profile, portrait prompt
agent.screenwriter.outline.title: Screenwriter: episode outline
agent.screenwriter.outline.desc: Writes what happens in every act and scene, from the idea and the plan.
agent.screenwriter.outline.out: Titles, location, time, events and characters for each act and scene
agent.screenwriter.adapt.title: Screenwriter: adapt a text
agent.screenwriter.adapt.desc: When you supply a novel, script or story, adapts it into the same kind of outline.
agent.screenwriter.adapt.out: Titles, location, time, events and characters for each act and scene
agent.screenwriter.shots.title: Screenwriter: shots and dialogue
agent.screenwriter.shots.desc: Breaks a scene into shots and writes each shot's picture, action, dialogue and narration.
agent.screenwriter.shots.out: For each shot: framing, picture, action, dialogue, narration, duration
agent.scene.design.title: Scene design
agent.scene.design.desc: Describes each location and writes the prompt that generates its image.
agent.scene.design.out: Setting, lighting, atmosphere, key objects, scene image prompt
agent.composer.bgm.title: Composer: scene music
agent.composer.bgm.desc: Describes the background music for a scene's mood; the music model generates it.
agent.composer.bgm.out: Music prompt, tempo, key, instruments, loopable or not
agent.composer.theme.title: Composer: theme song
agent.composer.theme.desc: Describes the film's theme song, optionally with lyrics.
agent.composer.theme.out: Music prompt, lyrics, tempo, key, instruments
agent.sound.design.title: Sound design
agent.sound.design.desc: Lists ambience and action sound effects from the place, weather and actions.
agent.sound.design.out: Sound effect list: name, category, timing, duration, description
agent.shot.visual.title: Shot visuals
agent.shot.visual.desc: Writes each shot as prompts for the image and video models, with the characters' looks and the style, so shots match.
agent.shot.visual.out: Image prompt, video prompt, negative prompt, camera movement
agent.reviewer.script.title: Reviewer: check the script
agent.reviewer.script.desc: Reads the script for contradictions, gaps and breaks in continuity and suggests fixes. Changes nothing.
agent.reviewer.script.out: Overall score, list of issues (severity, problem, suggested fix)
agent.var.title: Title
agent.var.name: Name
agent.var.subject: Song subject
field.name: Name
field.title: Title
error.dependency_failed: The step before this one did not complete
error.dependency_failed.remediation: Retry the earlier step, then submit the pipeline again.
api.error.workshop_unknown_kind: This module does not support that kind.
api.error.workshop_unknown_kind.remediat: Pick a kind from the module page.
api.error.workshop_missing_input.remedia: Fill in the inputs marked * and try again.
api.error.workshop_wrong_model: That model does not belong to this kind.
api.error.workshop_wrong_model.remediati: Choose a model listed under this kind.
api.error.workshop_empty_pipeline: A pipeline needs at least one step.
api.error.pipeline_no_previous: The first step has no previous step to take from.
api.error.pipeline_no_previous.remediati: Give the first step its own file or text.
api.error.pipeline_incompatible: The previous step's output is not the kind of file this step needs.
api.error.pipeline_incompatible.remediat: Pick a step that fits, e.g. image to video, voice to avatar.
workshop.field.consent: The speaker agreed to be cloned
web.workshop.title: Workshop
web.workshop.intro: Every module works on its own: pick a model, tune the parameters, get a result. Or chain modules in a pipeline: each step's output goes to the next.
web.workshop.params_hint: These are the effective parameters (model defaults + quality tier + your saved changes). Edits apply to this run only; press "Save as default" to keep them.
web.workshop.pick_asset: or paste an asset id / file path
web.workshop.pipeline_hint: A step starts when the one before it is done. If a step fails, the steps waiting for it are cancelled.
workshop.field.language: Language of the text (empty = interface language)
workshop.field.story: Story (a text file or the previous step)
agent.workshop.story.title: Workshop: write a story
agent.workshop.story.desc: Turns an idea into a story (people, wants, obstacles, turning points, ending). Used by the Story module of the workshop.
agent.workshop.story.out: A title and the story as plain text
agent.workshop.script.title: Workshop: write a script
agent.workshop.script.desc: Turns a story into a script with scenes, action and dialogue. Used by the Script module of the workshop.
agent.workshop.script.out: Scenes with heading, description and dialogue as plain text
api.error.workshop_bad_value.remediation: Check the highlighted field (a number is expected) and try again.
workshop.field.trigger: Trigger word (a rare word that calls the subject up in prompts)
workshop.field.likeness_consent: The person pictured agreed to this
web.library.title: Asset library
web.library.intro: Everything that was made or uploaded — stories, scripts, images, songs, accompaniments, dialogue, videos, LoRAs — each with an ID you can use to call it from anywhere. Give an item a name to keep it under a stable reference.
web.library.search: Search by ID, kind or name
web.library.empty: Nothing here yet. Make something in the Workshop or a project.
web.library.empty_named: No named items yet. Open an item and choose "File under a name".
web.library.name: Name
web.library.voice_consent: The speaker agreed to be cloned
web.library.trash_confirm: Move this item to the trash? The file stays on disk and can be restored by an operator.
web.library.remove_confirm: Remove {ref}? Jobs that use this name will stop finding it.
web.library.how_title: How to use an item (call it from elsewhere)
web.library.how_intro: Every item has an ID. Anywhere an input takes a file, write its reference instead of a path; the worker resolves it when the job runs, and the exact file is recorded in the job.
web.library.how.input: In a Workshop form: type or paste the reference, or press "Use as…" on a card
web.library.how.pipeline: In a pipeline: take the result of the step before
web.library.how.lora: A LoRA in image generation: the LoRA field of the Image module, or the parameter
web.library.how.cli_example: storyagent media submit --kind video.avatar --input image=asset:<ID> --input audio=asset:<ID>
workshop.field.shots: Shots in order (picture, spoken line, voice)
workshop.field.title: Title (optional)
web.workshop.shot.image: Still picture (used when there is no clip)
web.workshop.shot.seconds: Planned seconds (the voice may make it longer)
workflow.error.bad_target: The target length is not valid.
workflow.error.bad_target.remediation: Give the wanted length in seconds (for example 30, 120 or 5400).
web.workflow.target_hint: Seconds, anything from an advert to a feature film. Decides how many acts, scenes and shots are written and how long each shot is planned. Empty = the profile's.
error.remote_not_allowed: {model} runs in the cloud ({service}): your prompts and files would leave this machine
error.remote_not_allowed.remediation: Allow cloud models for this project (project setting allow_remote) or globally ([runtime] allow_remote = true in services.toml), then retry.
error.missing_credentials: The API key is missing: environment variable {env} is not set
error.missing_credentials.remediation: Set that environment variable for the worker (the key is never stored in a config file), restart the worker and retry.
